svg.text: llama.cpp ÷ nibble tok/s, paired ABBA blocks (median, bar = min–max over blocks)
Above 1: llama.cpp faster. Solid line = parity; dashed red = the 1.5× target.
Block = llama.cpp, nibble, nibble, llama.cpp back to back; ratio = mean A ÷ mean B.
Hollow = some run in the blocks was noisy (1-min load average > 2 when it started).
